summary: Intent-indexed first-tool routing vocabulary for repo-aware agents. This data guides workspace_tool_router_recommend and discovery metadata; it does not dispatch, mutate, lint, or replace the authority of the recommended tools.

authority.misuse_code_policy: Do not define WK-1437 misuse codes in this file. Replacement guidance names tools and bounded reasons only until the WK-1437 tool-use-policy.v1 vocabulary is available.

matched.description: Exactly one routing intent is selected after deterministic overlap handling.

ambiguous.description: Two or more intents remain plausible after deterministic overlap handling and available prerequisite state is insufficient to choose.

bounded_guidance.ask_for: the smallest missing identifier, state marker, or user choice needed to distinguish the candidate intents

unknown.description: No routing intent matches the task after normalization and phrase matching.
unknown.deterministic_no_match_behavior: Return unknown without guessing, reading records, dispatching, mutating, linting, or selecting a broad/full tool as a fallback.

guidance: Use workspace_tools_query or workspace_tools_describe only for bounded tool discovery when the task is still a repo-tool question.
Use workspace_search_repo only when the user is asking for docs/wiki lookup or canonical page discovery.
Ask the user for the missing durable identifier or scope when the task cannot be classified from the provided text.

normalization: treat hyphen, underscore, slash, and whitespace as token separators
preserve durable identifiers such as IN-*, WK-*, WK-*#SLICE-*, DEC-*, SRC-*, and docs paths as prerequisite state

overlap_rules.when: task asks to launch, start, assign, run, or dispatch a worker, reviewer, or redteam role
overlap_rules.reason: role dispatch still starts with readiness validation, but the user intent is a role call

overlap_rules.when: task asks whether a unit is dispatchable or ready without asking to launch a role
overlap_rules.reason: dispatch readiness is a structured decision, not manual record inspection

overlap_rules.when: task includes a selected slice address such as WK-0001#SLICE-002 or asks for one slice's detail
overlap_rules.reason: selected-slice reads avoid full tracker payloads

overlap_rules.when: task asks what should happen next, next action, frontier action, blocker to clear, or prepare dispatch across an initiative
overlap_rules.reason: next-action questions need the action lens, not only status counts

overlap_rules.when: task asks for status, where things stand, open counts, or current frontier without action language
overlap_rules.reason: initiative state is aggregated by the status lens, not docs search

use_when: The user asks for the current state, status, frontier, counts, or blockers for an initiative or selected unit.
The user asks where an initiative stands without requesting a specific next action or role launch.

forbidden_first_tools.reason: Search finds documents and records; it does not aggregate initiative state.
A full or selected record summary is a follow-up after the status lens selects a unit.
Raw record reads are not the compact first step for broad status.

prerequisite_state.name: initiative_or_unit
prerequisite_state.if_missing: return ambiguous if the task could apply to several initiatives or units; otherwise ask for the initiative or unit id

replacement_guidance.when: the task asks for initiative status, frontier, blockers, or current state

use_when: The user asks what should happen next for an initiative or selected unit.
The user asks to prepare the next coordinator action, identify the next dispatch candidate, or choose the next blocker to clear.

forbidden_first_tools.reason: Search does not compute the initiative action frontier.
Reading raw records first samples state instead of using the compact action lens.
Dispatch requires a selected ready unit and readiness validation first.

prerequisite_state.name: initiative_or_unit
prerequisite_state.if_missing: ask for the initiative or unit id before choosing a next action

replacement_guidance.when: the task asks what to do next or which unit to act on
the next action may be dispatch but readiness has not been validated

use_when: The user asks for the contract, acceptance criteria, dependencies, blockers, closure, write scope, or selected context for a known WK record.
The task starts from a known WK-* and needs compact work-record details before implementation, review, or coordination.

forbidden_first_tools.reason: The record id is already known; search is not the selected-record reader.
Default to the compact summary before full/debug record payloads.
Direct page reads are for known docs paths or targeted selected-slice reads, not routine compact WK context.

prerequisite_state.name: unit
prerequisite_state.if_missing: return ambiguous with docs_lookup if the task only gives keywords; ask for the WK id or use docs lookup if the user is searching

replacement_guidance.when: a WK id is already known and selected record context is requested

use_when: The user asks for one slice's details, notes, acceptance, validation, or closure.
The task includes a selected slice address such as WK-1438#SLICE-002.

forbidden_first_tools.reason: Full tracker reads are unnecessary for one selected slice.
The selected slice id is already the locator.
Use selected-slice page reads only when the caller specifically needs canonical JSON page projection; the compact summary is the normal first step.

prerequisite_state.name: slice_unit
prerequisite_state.if_missing: ask for the slice id or return ambiguous with selected_work_record_context

replacement_guidance.when: the task targets one selected slice

use_when: The user asks whether a WK or slice is dispatchable, ready, blocked, or valid for a role.
The task needs the structured dispatch-readiness decision before a role call.

forbidden_first_tools.reason: Role launch must not start before readiness validation.
Manual record inspection is not the readiness authority.
Search cannot decide dispatch readiness.

prerequisite_state.name: unit
prerequisite_state.if_missing: ask for the WK or slice id

prerequisite_state.name: role
prerequisite_state.if_missing: omit dispatch_role when the readiness question is role-agnostic

replacement_guidance.when: the user asks whether launch is allowed or readiness is unknown

use_when: The user asks to start, launch, dispatch, assign, or run a worker, reviewer, or redteam role for a WK, slice, or initiative.
The user names a wrapper command but the intended action is a role dispatch.

forbidden_first_tools.reason: The role call path starts with readiness validation; dispatch is the allowed follow-up only after a dispatchable result.
Search is not role-call admission.
Manual record reads do not replace dispatch readiness.

prerequisite_state.name: unit
accepted_sources: user-provided IN-* for redteam where supported
prerequisite_state.if_missing: ask for the dispatch subject id

replacement_guidance.when: an agent is asked to start a role call from inside an agent session
dispatch readiness has not already returned dispatchable

use_when: The user asks for the status, result, output, failure, or completion of an already dispatched agent run.
The task includes a monitor handle or run id and asks what happened.

forbidden_first_tools.reason: Search cannot resolve launcher run lifecycle.
The work record is not the runtime status authority for an active run.
Do not relaunch to learn the status of an existing run.

prerequisite_state.name: monitor_handle
prerequisite_state.if_missing: ask for the monitor handle; do not infer from a run id alone unless the monitoring tool supports that field

replacement_guidance.when: the task asks about an existing run

use_when: The user asks which docs or wiki page explains a concept, protocol, area, decision, source, or repository context.
The task is canonical page discovery and no exact page path is already known.

forbidden_first_tools.reason: Record reads require a known durable id; use search for page discovery.
Work-record summaries are not general docs lookup.
Docs lookup is read-only and must not launch roles.

prerequisite_state.name: query_or_path
prerequisite_state.if_missing: ask for the topic or path

replacement_guidance.when: the user asks to find the canonical docs/wiki page and no durable id is known

use_when: The user asks to inspect repo lint, generated-view lint, docs policy, validation findings, or repair a lint finding.
The task is read-only lint verification or a lint-fix workflow assigned by a WK.

forbidden_first_tools.reason: Search does not produce authoritative lint diagnostics.
Generate-and-lint writes generated views; start with read-only lint unless generated output refresh is explicitly required.
Routine read-only verification is coordinator-owned and is not a role dispatch.

prerequisite_state.name: lint_scope
prerequisite_state.if_missing: run bounded repo lint only when the task is repo-wide; otherwise ask for the file or validation surface

replacement_guidance.when: the task asks for lint diagnostics

use_when: The user asks to create, update, close, reopen, status-change, add closure, edit acceptance, edit list fields, or shape a review unit for a work record.
The task requires schema-backed persistence to a canonical WK, issue, initiative, decision, source, or area record.

recommended_first_tool.name: $validated_work_record_mutation_tool
recommended_first_tool.selection: derive from mutation_operation; return ambiguous if the operation is not known
recommended_first_tool.note: Mutation routing points to validated create/setter routes. Use workspace_work_record_summary only as a follow-up when a setter needs compact current state.

forbidden_first_tools.reason: Mutation workflows should start from compact current state and then use validated setters.
Raw page reads are not mutation authority.
Routine work-record mutations should use validated setter/create routes when available.

prerequisite_state.name: mutation_target
accepted_sources: record kind plus title for create
prerequisite_state.if_missing: ask for the record id or record kind/title before recommending a setter

prerequisite_state.name: mutation_operation
prerequisite_state.if_missing: ask which work-record operation is intended

replacement_guidance.when: the mutation is supported by a structured setter
the mutation operation is known and supported by a structured setter
the task is already a specific create, status, task, closure, list-field, acceptance, slice, or review-unit mutation
